purpose: Johnny-supplied evaluation questions, separate from the 25 development questions. Do not use these to select episodes, guide extraction, or search for answers before evaluation.
independence_limit: The coordinating assistant saw the questions before extraction. Evaluation-stage lexical lookups were run only after all ten draft extractions were created. Expected answers have not been supplied; no accuracy score can be assigned.
coverage_rule: Evaluate against the declared processed corpus. If supporting episodes are outside the ten-episode pilot, report scope uncertainty and defer full-archive recall evaluation; do not treat missing pilot coverage as proof of no show coverage.

questions.question: What is the best version of super mario 3 to collect?
questions.evaluation_notes: Interpret as a CQ archive question. Preserve the speaker, date, criteria and edition distinctions behind any recommendation; do not substitute a generic current recommendation.

observed_result.qualification: Supports a conditional buying opinion, not an established universal best edition. CQ 300's auction aside also tempers hype. Attribution remains contextual.

questions.question: What are two rare japanese only games Tyler bought?
questions.evaluation_notes: Support both game identities, the purchase attribution to Tyler, and the regional-exclusivity claim independently. A mention alone does not establish a purchase.

observed_result.qualification: Broad lexical lookup returns collecting and purchase leads but does not establish both intended games plus Tyler purchase and Japanese-only release scope. Do not substitute unrelated purchases or guesses.

questions.question: WHat is a weird virtual boy game Johnny talked about in a Halloween episode?
questions.evaluation_notes: Support game identity, platform, Halloween episode context and Johnny attribution. Isolate speaker uncertainty if the transcript does not establish it.

observed_result.qualification: Broad query returned false-positive Game Boy material. Requiring the complete Virtual Boy phrase isolates unrelated set discussion in CQ 200, not a supported Halloween-game answer. Pilot miss is not archive absence.

retrieval_findings: Phrase and speaker-candidate filters added after the first evaluation lookup; this is a development repair, not an untouched holdout result.
No expected answers were invented. No follow-up question is required to continue review.
